question: What are the names of the singers that have more than one songs?
sql:
SELECT s.Name
FROM singer s
JOIN song s1 ON s.Singer_ID = s1.Singer_ID
JOIN song s2 ON s.Singer_ID = s2.Singer_ID
WHERE s1.Song_ID < s2.Song_ID;
